ns2:course.label: Prin and Meth of Tchg Psych
ns2:course.description: Designed for graduate students in psychology; areas considered include developing course objectives and content; developing and presenting teaching-learning situations; evaluating the attainment of course objectives; advising and counseling students; ethics in teaching; and research problems on the teaching of psychology. Approved for letter and S/U grading. Prerequisite: Second-year graduate standing in psychology or consent of instructor.
